testDescription.val: For a given traffic pair data rate, determine the number of STAs (vSTAs) that can be used to achieve a given packet error rate.  Remember that in order to get packet loss measurements, you must use only a single parallel traffic stream.
testDescription.label: Test Description

settlingTime.label: Time to ignore test data at the beginning of test. (sec) [integer]

trainingInterval.label: Time to ignore test data at start of each attenuator step. (sec) [integer]

stepDuration.label: How long to spend at each attenuation step (seconds). NOTE: Use as long a duration as you can especially with high VSTA counts.  iPerf can take a while to start up.

testUses.label: Instruments required for this test. SD2 format

palsToUse.label: List of Pals on which to create vstas.

vstaSettings.label: Settings for the vSTAs, per radio.

trafficType.label: Traffic type to run [iperf2 | iperf3 | ping | None] NOTE! For a large number of VSTAs, select iperf2 rather than iperf3

trafficBW.label: Traffic bandwidth. Use K/M suffix; 0 for unlimited [string].

length.label: Length field.  This is the packet size, in bytes, for UDP.

parallel.label: Number of parallel iPerf traffic streams. NOT the same as spatial streams for MIMO.

window.label: Window size for iPerf in bytes.  Use #K or #M, like 2M for 2 MBytes.

stepSizeTarget.label: Maximum binary search step size allowed before search can terminate.

lossQuantile.label: Find lost packet for this quantile in each measurement.

vstaWait.label: Number of seconds to wait per vSTA for association and config push

autotest_timeout_factor.label: Extend length of time test runs from calculation by this much

doPingCheck.label: True to enable ping association checks.
